description: Look up what size, format or dimensions a photo or upload must be for a specific form: US passport photo size, US visa or DS-160 photo requirements, Green Card (DV) lottery photo rules, Schengen visa photo size, UK online passport photo rules, or IBPS photo, signature, thumb impression and declaration sizes.
